subject.title: fix(daemon): gateway fails to launch on Windows when the profile path contains CJK characters

question: Should OpenClaw authorize `iconv-lite@0.7.2` as a direct root dependency for deterministic legacy Windows launcher encoding on this exact PR head?
rationale: External PR dependency-graph changes are deliberately blocked, and replacing this dependency would require choosing a different Windows encoding strategy with different process and compatibility tradeoffs.

options.title: Authorize the dependency
options.body: Approve the exact `iconv-lite@0.7.2` promotion, retain the marker-based implementation, and gate merge on the rebased Windows and dependency checks.

options.title: Require a no-new-dependency design
options.body: Ask for a UTF-8 plus explicit code-page bootstrap approach and require fresh proof that child-process behavior and readback remain compatible.

options.title: Move implementation in-house
options.body: Pause this branch and have an authorized maintainer recreate the dependency and lockfile portion internally while preserving the contributor's encoding design and credit.

recommendation.title: Authorize the dependency
recommendation.body: Approve the exact `iconv-lite@0.7.2` promotion, retain the marker-based implementation, and gate merge on the rebased Windows and dependency checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the affected hidden-launcher path and have the strongest observed current-main connection to the Windows gateway surface requiring the decision.
